versions.localizedDescription:
MiruShin continues to evolve as a modern and comfortable way to watch and discover media, with each update focused on making the experience smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable across the app.

What's New:

• Fixed repeated AniList settings requests and unnecessary library reloads that could quickly trigger Too many requests.

• Watching keeps its visible list and scroll position during background updates.
• Removed duplicate startup library reads and reuse recent Board data to reduce background API traffic.

v2.9.23:

• Full Google Drive Library sync is now off by default, including after an update, with a separate switch on each device to enable it or restore an older full backup.
• Library loading and catalog updates no longer wait for Google Drive in the default mode. The selected AniList, MyAnimeList, or Shikimori catalog supplies the Library, with local data and queued changes available during outages.
• Episode resume positions, rewatch cycles, and saved source, voiceover, and quality choices sync through compact files without transferring full Library metadata or history. Settings, addons, and account connections continue syncing.
• Preserve intentional playback resets and newer positions during old-backup restoration, handle cross-device conflicts safely, and cancel full Library transfers when the switch is turned off.

v2.9.22:

• Fixed excessive memory growth in AniList, MyAnimeList, Shikimori, and Google Drive sync by releasing completed network requests.
• Reduced memory spikes while preparing Library backups and checking sync history, without discarding saved data or Undo history.

v2.9.21:

• Fixed incorrect episode-behind badges on finished anime.

• Handled broadcast statuses consistently across AniList, MyAnimeList and Shikimori without changing watch progress or library data.

v2.9.20:

• Airing metadata refreshes independently of watch progress and syncs between devices through Google Drive without generating upload echoes.
• Added Shikimori aired-episode counts and next-airing dates as a fallback when AniList scheduling data is unavailable.
• Added Russian and Japanese episode-backlog labels and regression tests for provider refreshes and cross-device schedule updates.

v2.9.19:

• Reduce Library-related UI stalls by reusing unchanged metadata and moving large native decoding and checksum work off the UI thread.
• Defer Google Drive sync while the player is open, keep progress saved locally, and automatically resume queued changes after leaving the player.
• Improve sync coordination during episode transitions and player shutdown, with safer deferred-sync status handling.

v2.9.18:

• Export your active Local Library from Settings to MyAnimeList XML or Shikimori JSON, including pending local edits, manga volumes, scores and dates where supported. Export works offline and reports entries without verified target IDs.
• Find Sources now starts with saved titles and enriches Russian, Japanese and English names independently, so AniList outages no longer block Russian searches. Provider matches are verified and cancelled searches stop their enrichment requests.
• Added optional MPV/FVP playback diagnostics with D-key micro-pause marking and manually saved, redacted reports. Diagnostics are at the end of Player Settings; no marker buttons or automatic report uploads.

v2.9.17:

• Choose AniList, MyAnimeList, or Shikimori as the only incoming library sync source; AniList is the default.
• Keep other connected catalogs as outgoing mirrors without allowing their edits or outages to overwrite the local library or switch the source.
• Safely retire obsolete destination conflicts and queued imports when changing the source, preserving local edits and audit history.
• Recover outgoing updates independently after restart and preserve unknown catalog-specific fields.

v2.9.16:

• Prevent unrelated catalog write echoes from downgrading Completed entries or clearing disputed dates and notes.
• Save conflict choices immedi
